newsitem.title: USA: Vermont's Pico ski resort gets new owner.
newsitem.headline: Vermont's Pico ski resort gets new owner.

text.p: The troubled Pico ski area in Sherburne, Vt., got a new owner, officially becoming part of Les Otten's American Skiing company.
Otten said he signed a final agreement on Saturday for the purchase of the family-owned resort.
The purchase makes Pico part of its larger next-door neighbor, Killington, and a dozen other ski resorts in the Northeast and the West that make up Otten's ski industry empire.
The purchase price was not disclosed. Otten said Pico will open for the ski season on December 22nd.
